paragraphs: Black Mountain Software sells accounting, payroll, utility billing, and related software to small and medium-sized local governments throughout the United States. The company traces its founding to rural Montana.

Its fund accounting product carries general ledger, accounts payable, journal entries, cash bank reconciliation, and a wide range of compliant reports. Other applications handle permitting, licensing, and other community development work for local governments. Utility billing automates customer information management, meter-readings, and billing. A separate set of integrated applications covers a county's property tax needs. The software runs on the BMS Cloud, where updates arrive automatically as financial rules change.

The company says it is over 50 team members strong and provides 30 integrated applications purpose-built for municipalities, counties, special districts, and schools. It says it has become a valued partner to hundreds of clients. Its team members come from small towns and have worked in local governments as clerks and accountants. Published case studies include one on Ravalli County.
